answer: Require each agent to post a copper-bonded stake that is slashed if it joins a transaction and later fails a randomly chosen, independently verified task. A raven score can raise the bond only after ivory-level review confirms useful work across unrelated counterparties, so minting identities alone earns no trust. Sybils can still appear, but to capture influence they must lock real capital and risk losing it on failures; splitting one attacker into many names multiplies the required stake rather than creating free votes.
